transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um... mostly, work sent me here. I guess I’ve just been forgetting things. Like... scheduled callbacks, work orders, just basic follow-ups I told people I'd do. It kind of piled up. So they told me I needed to come in... before I lose my shot at moving up.
Have you had this kind of difficulty with forgetting or following through since you were a child?

Yeah. I guess... it's been like this a long time. Even back in grade school, way before any of this pressure at work. 

My teachers usually said I was bright, but... I don't know, I was always losing my papers. Or I'd miss parts of the directions they gave us. They always had to remind me to just finish my classwork. So... yeah. Always been that way, I guess.
Have you ever had a head injury, stroke, seizure, or other brain illness?
No. Um... I haven't had anything like that.
Do you also have a hard time sitting still or feeling restless?
No. Um... not really. I don't have a problem with that. Sitting still is fine.
Do you often lose things you need for tasks, like papers, keys, or your phone?

Yeah. Um... I lose things a lot. 

At work, I'm... I'm always looking for my tablet or my keys. Or a flashlight. Even tools... I'll have a wrench in my hand, set it down, and a minute later I have no idea where it went. 

It slows me down. Makes me look bad, I guess. Like I don't care. But... yeah, it happens constantly.
Do these attention and follow-through problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work and outside of work?
Yeah. Um... it's not just at work. It happens at home, too. Pretty much... everywhere, I guess.
When someone gives you instructions, do you usually understand what they said right away?

Um... not always. Like... if my supervisor is talking straight to me about a repair, or an audit... I'll be looking right at him. But... I don't know, only the first part really sticks. I just... have to ask him to say it again.
Do you often feel restless or like you need to move around when you’re expected to sit still?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't feel like I need to move around a lot. Just... sitting still is fine.
Before age 12, did you have these attention or organization problems often?

Um... yeah. I think so. Back in grade school... it was pretty much the same. Long before any of this job pressure, anyway. My teachers used to say I was bright, but... I don't know, I just always misplaced my papers. Or I'd miss parts of the directions they gave us. They... they had to remind me a lot to just finish my classwork. So... yeah. Always been like that, I guess.
